verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
We glorify Your Name
We glorify Your Name
We glorify Your Name in all the earth

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Maker of the heavens
Master of the seas
Mover of the mountains
Majesty

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Awesome God in power
Author of my life
All consuming fire
Alive, alive

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You are seated on a throne of praise
Unto You alone, let our voices raise
